concat_location: model transform step; RandLANet.transform concatenates xyz and feat, so the dataset should return point and feat separately
split_object_api: The pipeline calls dataset.get_split('train'), dataset.get_split('validation'), and dataset.get_split('test'); get_split must return a BaseDatasetSplit-style object with __len__, get_data, get_attr, and sampler support.
registry_note: The pipeline uses the dataset instance directly. DATASET._register_module(...) is optional unless a separate factory-style config loader needs name-based lookup.
short_note: Implement a BaseDataset subclass plus a split subclass. The split object is what actually provides per-sample data. For RandLANet, the custom split should return point/feat/label even though the stock Pandaset split returns point/intensity/label; leave xyz+feat concatenation to RandLANet.transform.
